DEMOLITIONLICENSEAGREEMENT DEMOLITION LICENSE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement") made as of the I_ day of February,2016, between 16 EAST 39TH STREET LLC,hereinafter referred to as the “Purchaser,”having an office at c/oMcSamHotel Group,420 GreatNeck Road,GreatNeck, NY 11021, and 9 EAST 38TH STREET OWNER LLC, hereinafter referred to as the “Seller," having an office at c/o Juster Properties, 2001 West Main Street, Suite 244, Stamford, CT 06902. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed thereto in the Purchase and Sale Agreement between Seller and Grantor,dated December 23,2014 (as amended to date, the “PSA"). WHEREAS, the Purchaser is the fee owner of certain land located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 868 Lot 64 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,hereinafterreferred to asParcel A andmore particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule A annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof; WHEREAS,theSeller is thefee owner of certainlandlocated in the City andState of NewYork,Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 868Lot 12 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,hereinafter referred to asParcel B and more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule B annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof; WHEREAS, the property of the Seller, Parcel B, is situated to the south of the property of the Purchaser, Parcel A, and said parcels are contiguous to one another; Post-Closing Prep Work and, in order to perform such work, will be required from time to time to access Parcel A; and NOW, THEREFORE, good and valuable consideration having been paid, each of Seller and Purchaser for itself, its heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns, hereby agrees as follows: 1. Purchaser hereby grants and conveys to Seller, its heirs, legal representatives, successors and assigns,together with Seller's contractors, subcontractors,engineers,architects and other third parties necessary for the completion of the Post-Closing Prep Work, a license which shall commence on the date hereof and end on the date of the completion of the Post-Closing Prep Work (the“Demolition License") to access Parcel A to undertake and complete the Demolition Prep Work, including the installation of scaffolding, the storage of equipment and materials and other ancillary uses reasonably required in connection with the completion of thePost-ClosingWork.

2.Seller agrees that,in connection with its access toParcel A as providedpursuant to this Agreement, it shall continue to be obligated to comply with Section 26(l) and any other applicabletermsof thePSA. 3.Purchaser hereby agrees that the access granted pursuant to this Agreement shall be in ofthePSA. 4.Purchaser andSeller hereby agree that thisAgreement shall automatically terminate and the Demolition License shall automatically expire upon the completion of thePost-ClosingPrep 5.This Agreement shall be governed in accordance with the laws of theState of NewYork.
